sections.title: ARKLATEX/LOWER TO MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW IS FORECAST TO TRANSLATE SLOWLY EWD INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS TODAY AS A 75 TO 90 KT MID-LEVEL JET ON THE ERN SIDE OF THE SYSTEM...MOVES NEWD FROM THE SRN PLAINS INTO THE WRN OZARKS. AT THE SFC...A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE EWD ACROSS ECNTRL MO AND WRN AR. NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD BE ONGOING THIS MORNING BEHIND THE FRONT FROM WRN MO SSWWD INTO ECNTRL OK. THIS ACTIVITY COULD HAVE A HAIL THREAT. AHEAD OF THE FRONTAL BOUNDARY...SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD BE IN THE MID 60S F ACROSS ERN AR...SE MO AND SRN IL WHERE MODERATE DESTABILIZATION IS FORECAST BY EARLY TO MID AFTERNOON. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM COULD INITIATE DURING THE DAY ALONG THE CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING...THE MODELS FOCUS MOST OF THE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND TO THE WEST OF THE COLD FRONT WHERE A LINEAR MCS SHOULD ORGANIZE. FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT 03Z/THU NEAR THE MS RIVER FROM ERN AR NWD INTO SE MO SHOW SBCAPE VALUES OF 1000 TO 1500 J/KG WITH 50 TO 60 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. IN ADDITION...WINDS ARE UNIDIRECTIONAL IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS WITH 40 TO 50 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE SFC. FOR THIS REASON...THE STRONGER CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE MAY BE ABLE TO PRODUC

sections.title: OH VALLEY/CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY EXTENDING NWWD FROM THE OH VALLEY INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY. AT THE SFC...A LOW IS FORECAST TO MOVE EWD ACROSS NRN MO WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EWD FROM THE LOW ACROSS CNTRL IL...NRN IND...NRN OH INTO PA. SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS FORECAST WITH SFC DEWPOINTS FROM THE UPPER 50S TO THE LOWER 60S F. THE MODELS SUGGEST THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL INITIATE THIS AFTERNOON ALONG AND TO THE NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY WITH MORE ISOLATED CONVECTION POSSIBLE SWD ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. FORECAST SOUNDINGS BY 21Z AT INDIANAPOLIS AND PITTSBURG SHOW SBCAPE VALUES FROM 1000 TO 1500 J/KG WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 40 TO 45 KT. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD SUPPORT SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT. UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS AND STRONG LOW-LEVEL FLOW WOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ESPECIALLY WITH SHORT LINE-SEGMENTS THAT CAN PERSIST. HAIL COULD ALSO OCCUR WITH ELEVATED CELLS NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY OR WITH CELLS SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY THAT OBTAIN ROTATION. ..BROYLES/GARNER.. 04/10/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INITIALLY POSITIVELY TILTED TROUGH FROM THE NRN PLAINS TO SRN ROCKIES/NWRN MEXICO WILL ASSUME A NEUTRAL TILT OVER THE CNTRL CONUS AS A MIDLEVEL JET STREAK DEVELOPS FROM THE TROUGH BASE INTO THE OZARKS/MID MS VALLEY BY 11/12Z. WITHIN THIS LARGE-SCALE TROUGH...AN ELONGATED VORTICITY MAXIMUM /ON POLEWARD SIDE OF ABOVE-MENTIONED JET STREAK/ WILL PIVOT FROM THE SRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE UPPER/MID MS VALLEY AHEAD OF A MIDLEVEL LOW SLOWLY TRACKING EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS. DOWNSTREAM FROM THESE DEVELOPMENTS...REGIONAL RADAR DATA INDICATE A PAIR OF VORTICITY MAXIMA...ONE OVER NRN LOWER MI AND THE OTHER OVER NRN IL. THESE FEATURES WILL TRANSLATE EWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY TODAY...WITHIN THE SRN PERIPHERY OF A HIGH-MOMENTUM AIR STREAM PRESENT FROM CNTRL ONTARIO EWD TO THE CANADIAN MARITIMES. IN THE LOW LEVELS...A SURFACE CYCLONE OVER CNTRL IL WILL SLOWLY MOVE NEWD WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT ADVANCES TOWARD THE MIDDLE AND LOWER MS VALLEY. A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED BAROCLINIC ZONE CURRENTLY FROM THE SURFACE LOW ENEWD ACROSS NRN PARTS OF IND/OH INTO CNTRL PA/NJ WILL REMAIN QUASI-STATIONARY TODAY.

sections.title: OZARKS/MID MS VALLEY INTO THE SRN PLAINS AND LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: THOUGH THE MAJORITY OF NOCTURNAL TSTM ACTIVITY HAS REMAINED ELEVATED AND WELL-REMOVED FROM THE COLD FRONT AT THE SURFACE...MORE RECENT STORM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED INVOF OF THE FRONT FROM PARTS OF CNTRL/SWRN MO INTO ERN OK. AS THE ABOVE-MENTIONED VORTICITY MAXIMUM/JET STREAK LIFTS FROM THE MEAN TROUGH BASE...THE COMBINATION OF INCREASING HEIGHT FALLS INTO THE WARM SECTOR AND STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENT FLOW SHOULD FOSTER A STEADY INCREASE IN STORMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT THROUGH THE PEAK OF THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. THOUGH ANTECEDENT CONVECTION HAS PROCESSED MUCH OF THE EML OBSERVED IN PREVIOUS DAYS ACROSS THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS...12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS INDICATE A RESIDUAL CORRIDOR OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY INTO MID SOUTH. WHEN COUPLED WITH INCREASING BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE /I.E. DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S/...EXPECT AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES TO APPROACH 1000-2500 J/KG IN AREAS THAT RECEIVE THE STRONGEST SOLAR INSULATION. THE MERIDIONAL CHARACTER OF THE TROPOSPHERIC WIND FIELD /AND THE RESULTANT FRONT-PARALLEL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR/ WILL CONTINUE TO PROMOTE A PREDOMINANT...LINEAR CONVECTIVE MODE...THOUGH SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WI

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC COAST
sections.text: LATEST CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND MESOSCALE MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATE THAT ONGOING TSTMS OVER IL/IND WILL EVOLVE INTO ONE OR MULTIPLE TSTM COMPLEXES TODAY AS LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT IS ENHANCED BY THE ABOVE-MENTIONED VORTICITY MAXIMA. 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT THE REGION RESIDES ALONG THE NRN PERIPHERY OF AN EML THAT HAS BEEN ADVECTED TO THE ATLANTIC COAST. WHEN COUPLED WITH BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOWER 60S...EXPECT THE AIR MASS TO THE SOUTH OF THE SYNOPTIC FRONT TO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000-1500 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH MODERATELY STRONG WESTERLY FLOW WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF FORWARD-PROPAGATION OF STORM CLUSTERS WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH THIS EVENING. ..MEAD/MARSH.. 04/10/2013

sections.title: NRN LA AND CENTRAL/ERN AR TO IL THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL LOW IS EXPECTED TO DEEPEN OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS TODAY AND THE MID MO VALLEY TONIGHT...AS AN EMBEDDED JET STREAK ROTATES NNEWD FROM W TX TO OK/KS. IN RESPONSE...SLOW DEEPENING OF THE SURFACE LOW IS EXPECTED NEAR STL...WHILE THE TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVES ONLY SLOWLY EWD ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON...AND MORE QUICKLY SEWD TOWARD THE TX COAST. IN ADVANCE OF THE FRONT...A PLUME OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ORIGINATING FROM THE NW CARIBBEAN HAS SPREAD INLAND ACROSS LA/AR...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS HAVE REACHED THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 F. THIS MOISTENING HAS OCCURRED BENEATH A REMNANT EML PLUME WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OF 7.5-8.5 C/KM. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS SOME CLOUD BREAKS ACROSS MUCH OF AR...WHICH WILL ALLOW SURFACE TEMPERATURES TO WARM WELL INTO THE 70S THIS AFTERNOON...AND SUPPORT MLCAPE NEAR 2500 J/KG. ALSO...THE SLY LLJ WILL INCREASE GRADUALLY THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT FROM CENTRAL/ERN AR TO IL/INDIANA...IN RESPONSE TO THE DEEPENING MID MS VALLEY LOW. LIKEWISE...MID-UPPER SWLY FLOW WILL INCREASE WITH THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THE JET STREAK EJECTING NNEWD OVER ERN OK/KS. THE NET RESULT WILL BE AN ENVIRONMENT WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: A FEW SMALL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE ALREADY DEVELOPED ACROSS OH AS OF LATE MORNING...AND THIS CONVECTION SHOULD PERSIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WHILE SPREADING EWD INTO PA. INSTABILITY IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...WITH THE GREATEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE FEED INTO THE OH VALLEY FROM THE SW...BUT STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXTEND EWD TO THE MID ATLANTIC COAST. GIVEN THE LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY WIND PROFILES WITH UP TO 50 KT FLOW AROUND 500 MB...ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE...AS WELL AS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL W OF THE APPALACHIANS. ..THOMPSON/MOSIER.. 04/10/2013

sections.title: 20Z OUTLOOK UPDATE
sections.text: NO SUBSTANTIVE CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE 1630Z OUTLOOK...ASIDE FROM DECREASING AREAL COVERAGE WITH RISK FOR THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THE FLORIDA PENINSULA. SUBTROPICAL RIDGING CENTERED OFF THE SOUTH ATLANTIC COAST REMAINS STRONG...WITH BROADLY ANTICYCLONIC LOW-LEVEL FLOW LINGERING AS FAR WEST AS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...AND AS FAR NORTH AS THE OHIO VALLEY/NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS ARE CURRENTLY EVOLVING ALONG THE EDGE OF STRONGER CAPPING ON NORTHWESTERN AND NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF THIS FEATURE... WHERE WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY IN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATELY STRONG AND SHEARED DEEP LAYER WESTERLY FLOW WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORT WAVE IMPULSE LIFTING OUT OF THE BASE OF AMPLIFIED UPPER TROUGHING ACROSS THE PLAINS/SOUTHERN ROCKIES REGION DOES STILL APPEAR LIKELY TO ENHANCE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL IN AT LEAST A NARROW CORRIDOR ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN ARKANSAS INTO SOUTHEAST MISSOURI LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. BETWEEN THE SUBTROPICAL RIDGING...AND COLD AIR WHICH HAS DAMMED SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE PLAINS...AN AXIS OF SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS IS EXP

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CNTRL U.S. MID-UPPER LEVEL LOW WILL SLOWLY MOVE EWD THROUGH THURSDAY MORNING AS A SPEED MAX MOVES FROM OK/KS EARLY THIS EVENING TO THE MID MS VALLEY LATE. AN UPSTREAM DISTURBANCE WILL BEGIN TO MOVE ACROSS NRN MEXICO AND S TX THROUGH THE BASE OF THE LARGER SCALE CNTRL U.S. TROUGH BY DAYBREAK. IN THE LOW LEVELS...A LOW NEAR STL WILL DEVELOP NEWD ACROSS IL TONIGHT ALONG A BAROCLINIC ZONE THAT EXTENDS EWD FROM THE MID MS RIVER VALLEY EWD TO THE MID ATLANTIC STATES. A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: MID TO LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: AN EXTENSIVE...BROKEN STRONG TO SEVERE SQUALL LINE HAS DEVELOPED FROM ERN MO AND IL SWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY AND FURTHER UPSCALE GROWTH IS EXPECTED THIS EVENING AS THESE STORMS IMPINGE UPON AN UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR. MOISTURE RICH LOW LEVELS CHARACTERIZED BY 60S DEWPOINTS...EXTEND FROM THE SURFACE BOUNDARY OVER IL SWD...AND HAS CONTRIBUTED TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE EWD ADVANCING FRONT. MODELS SHOW DEEP TROPOSPHERIC FLOW FIELDS INCREASING MARKEDLY /E.G. H7 FLOW 50-60 KT/ OVER THE NRN PORTION OF THE WARM SECTOR INVOF THE MS/OH RIVER CONFLUENCE THIS EVENING AS THE CNTRL PLAINS SPEED MAX ENCROACHES ON THE AREA TONIGHT. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE WARM SECTOR WILL MAXIMIZE OVER ADJACENT PORTIONS IL/KY/MO DURING THE EVENING HOURS...PROMOTING ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES AND EMBEDDED CIRCULATIONS DESPITE THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. THIS WILL TEND TO FAVOR A DMGG WIND THREAT WITH TIME...IN ADDITION TO AN ATTENDANT CONDITIONAL QLCS/SUPERCELL TORNADO RISK WITH THE STRONGER CIRCULATIONS.

sections.title: MIDDLE OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC THIS EVENING
sections.text: THE WEST-EAST ORIENTED BAROCLINIC ZONE WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR SHOWERS/TSTMS THROUGH THE MID EVENING WITH MUCH OF THE ACTIVITY LOCATED NEAR OR N OF THE BOUNDARY. WHILE INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY DIMINISH SOMEWHAT OWING TO THE LOSS OF HEATING...STRONG LOW TO MID LEVEL FLOW SAMPLED BY AREA RAOBS/VWPS THIS EVENING MAY CONTINUE TO LEND AN ISOLD DMGG WIND/HAIL RISK WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. ..SMITH.. 04/11/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTER OF TSTMS WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS NE OH AND INTO WRN PA. SOME ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE AS IT MOVES EWD...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW STRONG GUSTS. ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT WILL LIKELY PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS THE TSTM CLUSTER OVER NE OH/FAR NW PA IS BECOMING A LITTLE BETTER ORGANIZED. A STRONG STORM HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED ACROSS CNTRL OH WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN THIS AREA LIKELY. THUS FAR...UPDRAFTS HAVE HAD TROUBLE MAINTAINING STRENGTH...PRIMARILY DUE TO THE WEAK MID-LEVEL INSTABILITY RESULTANT FROM GENERALLY POOR LAPSE RATES. DESPITE THIS MARGINAL INSTABILITY...STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL SHEAR HAS ALLOW SOME STORMS TO PERSIST. SOME STORM ORGANIZATION APPEARS TO BE ONGOING WITH THE EVENTUAL DEVELOPMENT INTO A CONVECTIVE LINE ANTICIPATED. PRIMARY THREAT WHILE THE LINE GETS ORGANIZED IS SOME SMALL TO MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AND A GUSTY WINDS. ONCE THE LINE BECOMES ESTABLISHED...SHEAR VECTORS ORIENTED PERPENDICULAR TO THE LINE AND SOME BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING WILL LIKELY FAVOR A FEW STRONG GUSTS. TRENDS ACROSS THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR ANY ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT/STRENGTHENING BUT CURRENT EXPECTATION IS THAT COVERAGE OF ANY SVR WINDS WILL BE ISOLATED...PRECLUDING THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. A WATCH MAY BE REQUIRED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE ERUPTED ALONG AND N OF THE SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY FROM CNTRL IL EWD INTO OH. HEATING AND LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION COUPLED WITH RELATIVELY COOL TEMPERATURE PROFILES ALOFT HAVE LED TO MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION INCLUDING BOWS OR SUPERCELLS AND IS ORIENTED NEARLY PARALLEL TO THE FRONT. LARGE HAIL APPEARS LIKELY...WITH DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE WITH STORMS WHICH MOVE EWD ALONG THE FRONT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON...AND ARE EXPECTED TO CHANGE CHARACTER LATER TODAY WITH TORNADOES...VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS LIKELY. TORNADO WATCHES ARE FORTHCOMING SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COLD FRONT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM S CNTRL MO ACROSS WRN AR TO JUST SW OF TEXARKANA AS OF 18Z...WITH A WARM FRONT TO THE SW OF ST. LOUIS. HEATING HAS ERODED MOST OF THE CIN ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR WITH TEMPERATURES MAINLY IN THE 76-81 RANGE. THE 18Z LZK SOUNDING SHOWS THAT THE CAPPING INVERSION IS NEARLY GONE WITH A DEEPENING BOUNDARY LAYER EXTENDING ABOVE 700 MB. ALSO SHOWN IN THIS SOUNDING IS THAT THE MID TO UPPER LEVEL LAPSE RATES REMAIN STEEP...AND THAT MEAN LOW LEVEL MIXING RATIOS HAVE CHANGED LITTLE DESPITE HEATING. WIND PROFILES THIS FAR E OF THE COLD FRONT HAVE NOT YET RESPONDED TO THE APPROACHING TROUGH...BUT THIS APPEARS TO BE HAPPENING SW TOWARD SHV WHERE 850 MB FLOW WAS MORE BACKED. ISOLATED STORMS HAVE BEGUN TO FORM ALONG THE FRONT ACROSS SWRN AR AND NERN TX...AND SHOULD GRADUALLY DEEPEN. OVER TIME...LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL STRENGTHEN AND BACK FURTHER...POSSIBLY ENHANCED BY A ZONE OF DEVELOPING PRESSURE FALLS JUST AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. AS THIS OCCURS...HODOGRAPHS WILL BECOME ENLARGED AND THE CHARACTER OF THE CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO CHANGE FROM DISORGANIZED/MARGINAL SEVERE TO SUPERCELLULAR WITH A TORNADO AND HAIL THREAT. GIVEN SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE AND LARGE LI/S...A COUPLE STRONG TORNADOES MAY OCCUR. DURING THE EVENING...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONSOLIDATE ALONG THE FRONT...WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS AND/OR QLCS MODE. EVEN SO...STRONG SHEAR WILL FAVOR TORNADOES AND SWATHS OF DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF TSTMS ACROSS CNTRL IND AND NW OH ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST...RESULTING IN A PRIMARY SVR THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN THE MORE UNSTABLE AIR ACROSS THE SRN PORTION OF THE WATCH WILL FAVOR SOME SVR HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF TSTMS CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS CNTRL IND HAS RECENTLY MOVED ACROSS THE STATIONARY FRONT INTO AN AIRMASS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 70 AND LOW 80S...DEWPOINTS AROUND 60...MLCAPE AROUND 1500 J PER KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 50 KTS. AS SUCH...THIS LINE SHOULD PERSIST WITH SOME ADDITIONAL STRENGTHENING POSSIBLE. BOTH SVR WIND AND HAIL ARE POSSIBLE AS IT CONTINUES EWD. FARTHER E...ANOTHER LINE OF TSTMS IS CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH NW OH INTO N-CNTRL OH. SOME STRENGTHENING HAS BEEN NOTED WITH THIS LINE AS IT MOVES ALONG THE STATIONARY FRONT. AOH /IN NW OH/ REPORTED A 59 KT AS THIS LINE MOVED THROUGH. ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THIS LINE IS NOT QUITE AS FAVORABLE AS FARTHER W AND MESOANALYSIS INDICATES MLCAPE AROUND 1000 J PER KG. PRIMARY THREAT WITH THIS LINE IS SVR WIND. SRN END OF BOTH OF THESE LINES AS WELL AS ANY DISCRETE CELLS THAT DEVELOP IN THE WAA ACROSS THE SRN PORTION OF THE WATCH APPEAR TO HAVE THE GREATEST HAIL THREAT. RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SHOW UPDRAFTS ARE STRUGGLING TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY BUT NEW DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BE STRONG ENOUGH TO PRODUCE AT LEAST MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. ..MOSIER.. 04/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES TO INCREASE SLOWLY...WITH TORNADOES AND HAIL THE MAIN THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS STORMS INCREASING FROM THE ARKLATEX NNEWD ACROSS WRN AR ALONG OR JUST AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...WHICH WAS MOVING EWD AT AROUND 10 KT. THESE CELLS HAVE SHOWN WEAK CYCLONIC SHEAR NEAR THE UPDRAFT BASES...AND ARE GENERALLY INCREASING IN NUMBER. THE LZK HODOGRAPH CONTINUES TO IMPROVE WITH 0-1 SRH AROUND 200 M2/S2. OTHER STRONG STORMS WERE FORMING NEAR THE ANALYZED SURFACE LOW NEAR TXK...WITH THE SHV VWPS SHOWING STRONGER WINDS IN THE LOW LEVELS. AS SHEAR CONTINUES TO IMPROVE...SOME OF THESE CELLS MAY INTENSIFY AND PRODUCE TORNADOES AND LARGE HAIL AS THEY DEVELOP NEWD ACROSS CNTRL AND NRN AR. OTHER CELLS WERE FORMING IN THE WARM SECTOR FROM NERN AR INTO SERN MO...WITH MESOCYCLONES NOTED ON RADAR. THE ENVIRONMENT HERE ALSO REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND TORNADOES...ALTHOUGH THE MOST DANGEROUS THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATER THIS EVENING AS THE LOW DEEPENS AND LOW LEVEL JET INTENSIFIES. ..JEWELL.. 04/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NEAR/AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT...AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NORTHERN/CENTRAL LA INTO WESTERN MS. THIS INCLUDES POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING THUNDERSTORM WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO...MONITORING FOR A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PER RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY /SINCE 2045Z/...BOUNDARY LAYER CU FIELD WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR APPEARS TO BE DEEPENING ESPECIALLY ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST LA INTO FAR SOUTHWEST MS...INCLUDING AREAS 50-75 MILES EITHER SIDE OF I-20. THIS IS AHEAD A COLD FRONT WHICH EXTENDS SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD FROM A WEST-CENTRAL AR SURFACE LOW TO NEAR THE SHREVEPORT AREA INTO EXTREME EASTERN TX AS OF 21Z. WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR...BOUNDARY LAYER CINH NOW APPEARS NEGLIGIBLE AMID LOWER 80S SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND UPPER 60S OR NEAR 70F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. AS SUCH...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT WARM SECTOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT MAY CONTINUE TO OCCUR WITH ADDITIONAL DESTABILIZATION...ESPECIALLY GIVEN GRADUAL HEIGHT FALLS/STRONG DIFFLUENCE ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERAL OF A PLAINS UPPER TROUGH. COINCIDENT WITH THE ENTRANCE REGION OF A MODERATELY STRONG SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET...LOW-LEVEL/DEEP LAYER WILL SUPPORT WARM SECTOR SUPERCELLS AS UPDRAFTS CONTINUE TO MATURE...WITH A MORE LINEAR MODE NEAR THE COLD FRONT. THUNDERSTORM WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING...AND INCREASING TRENDS MAY PROMPT A WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TWO PRIMARY/BOWING TSTM COMPLEXES -- ONE MOVING NEWD OUT OF NERN PA...SECOND MOVING EWD FROM NERN OH -- ARE FCST TO OFFER DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL. EASTERN ONE WILL BE SHORTER-LIVED...MOVING INTO MORE STABLE AIR. WESTERN COMPLEX MAY PERSIST WITH SVR THREAT RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED NEAR OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM FIRST. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS ALONG THEIR OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES MAY PRODUCE OCNL HAIL AND GUSTS NEAR SVR LIMITS...BUT THREAT FROM THOSE APPEARS MRGL/TRANSIENT. ELEVATED CONVECTION WELL N OF BOUNDARY SHOULD REMAIN LARGELY SUB-SVR...BUT WITH ISOLATED HAIL NEAR SVR LIMITS AND STG GUSTS. NEW WW IS BEING CONSIDERED THAT WOULD COVER WRN COMPLEX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS INDICATED COLD MARINE BOUNDARY FROM NEAR ACY NNWWD ACROSS BUCKS COUNTY PA THAN ARCHING OVER PIKE COUNTY PA AND SULLIVAN COUNTY NY...HAVING ALREADY PASSED MSV. THIS BOUNDARY CORRESPONDS WELL TO FINE LINE EVIDENT IN COMPOSITE REFLECTIVITY ANIMATIONS...MOVING WWD 5-10 KT. THIS BOUNDARY WILL BE OVERTAKEN WITHIN NEXT 1-2 HOURS FROM N-S...BY MCS MOVING EWD 45-50 KT OVER NERN PA. QUASISTATIONARY FRONT INTERSECTED MCS OVER NERN PA NEAR BORDER WITH SULLIVAN COUNTY NY...AND EXTENDED ENEWD ACROSS SWRN MA. ITS DAMAGING-WIND THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH WITH NWD EXTENT FROM OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE STABLE LAYER BECOMES PROGRESSIVELY COOLER AND DEEPER. NEAR AND S OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...AIR MASS IS CHARACTERIZED BY SPORADICALLY WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS AWAY FROM SMALLER OUTFLOWS...SUPPORTING THREAT FOR SVR GUSTS.
